parts: Hi Martinique,

I thought i Should be storing my sleeplog file within my data folder

I have the following set up

Geneactive > Data
Geneactive > Results

Should I just store my sleep log in the geneactive folder rather than subfolder: Data?

As we discussed during the GGIR training you should never store files in the directory specified with parameter datadir. GGIR attempts to read any file that is in there under the assumption that it is an accelerometer data file.

Sleep diaries are not generated by an accelerometer and should therefore never be stored in the same folder as the accelerometer data. You can store them anywhere you like as long as it is not the datadir location and ideally also not inside the output directory generated by GGIR.

Best,

Vincent
